name: Runway Dev
desc: Developer platform for video, image and audio models via API
desc_zh: 面向开发者的视频、图片、音频模型 API 平台
solves: Picking one video model locks you into its limits; one API now routes requests across Runway and third-party models.
solves_zh: 只接一家视频模型会被它的上限卡住；一个 API 现在能调用 Runway 和第三方的多个模型。
best_for: Your app needs clips from two different models with one billing account; start from the Runway Dev quickstart.
best_for_zh: 应用要用两家模型的视频、又不想开两套账号时，从 Runway Dev 的快速上手文档开始。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — link found in https://runway.com/news/company-news/introducing-runway-media-）。 Runway Dev is the current name of Runway's developer platform; it grew out of the Runway API (2024) and now hosts Runway's own models plus third-party ones. TechCrunch wrote that Runway Dev was 'released earlier this month' (July 2026). dev.runwayml.com redirects to dev.runway.com. 首次公开日期来源：https://runway.com/news/company-news/introducing-runway-dev
